`--fasta_reference`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Use FILE as the reference sequence for analysis. An index file (FILE.fai) will be created if none exists. If neither --targets nor --region are specified, FreeBayes will analyze every position in this reference.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"reference.fasta"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--fasta_reference_index`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Use FILE.fai as the index of reference sequence for analysis.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"file.fai"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--targets`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Limit analysis to targets listed in the BED-format FILE.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"targets.bed"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--region`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Limit analysis to the specified region, 0-base coordinates, end_position not included (same as BED format).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--samples`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Limit analysis to samples listed (one per line) in the FILE. By default FreeBayes will analyze all samples in its input BAM files.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"samples.txt"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--populations`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Each line of FILE should list a sample and a population which it is part of. The population-based bayesian inference model will then be partitioned on the basis of the populations.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"populations.txt"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cnv_map`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Read a copy number map from the BED file FILE, which has either a sample-level ploidy or a region-specific format.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gvcf`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Write gVCF output, which indicates coverage in uncalled regions.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gvcf_chunk`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
When writing gVCF output emit a record for every NUM bases.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--variant_input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Use variants reported in VCF file as input to the algorithm. Variants in this file will included in the output even if there is not enough support in the data to pass input filters.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"variant_input.vcf"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--only_use_input_alleles`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Only provide variant calls and genotype likelihoods for sites and alleles which are provided in the VCF input, and provide output in the VCF for all input alleles, not just those which have support in the data.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--haplotype_basis_alleles`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
When specified, only variant alleles provided in this input VCF will be used for the construction of complex or haplotype alleles.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--report_all_haplotype_alleles`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
At sites where genotypes are made over haplotype alleles, provide information about all alleles in output, not only those which are called.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--report_monomorphic`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Report even loci which appear to be monomorphic, and report all considered alleles, even those which are not in called genotypes.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--pvar`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Report sites if the probability that there is a polymorphism at the site is greater than N. Note that post-filtering is generally recommended over the use of this parameter.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--strict_vcf`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Generate strict VCF format (FORMAT/GQ will be an int).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--theta`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The expected mutation rate or pairwise nucleotide diversity among the population under analysis. This serves as the single parameter to the Ewens Sampling Formula prior model.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.001`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--ploidy`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Sets the default ploidy for the analysis to N.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `2`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--pooled_discrete`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Assume that samples result from pooled sequencing. Model pooled samples using discrete genotypes across pools.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--pooled_continuous`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Output all alleles which pass input filters, regardles of genotyping outcome or model.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--use_reference_allele`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
This flag includes the reference allele in the analysis as if it is another sample from the same population.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--reference_quality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Assign mapping quality of MQ to the reference allele at each site and base quality of BQ.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"100,60"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--throw_away_snp_obs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Ignore SNP alleles.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--throw_away_mnps_obs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Ignore multi-nuceotide polymorphisms, MNPs. MNPs are excluded as default.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_false`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--throw_away_indel_obs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Ignore insertion and deletion alleles. Indels are excluded as default.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_false`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--throw_away_complex_obs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Ignore complex events (composites of other classes). Complex are excluded as default
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_false`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--use_best_n_alleles`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Evaluate only the best N SNP alleles, ranked by sum of supporting quality scores.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--max_complex_gap`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Allow haplotype calls with contiguous embedded matches of up to this length.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `3`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_repeat_size`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
When assembling observations across repeats, require the total repeat length at least this many bp.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `5`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_repeat_entropy`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
To detect interrupted repeats, build across sequence until it has entropy > N bits per bp. Set to 0 to turn off.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--no_partial_observations`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Exclude observations which do not fully span the dynamically-determined detection window.  (default, use all observations, dividing partial support across matching haplotypes when generating haplotypes.)
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--dont_left_align_indels`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Turn off left-alignment of indels, which is enabled by default.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--use_duplicate_reads`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Include duplicate-marked alignments in the analysis. default: exclude duplicates marked as such in alignments
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_mapping_quality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Exclude alignments from analysis if they have a mapping quality less than Q.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_base_quality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Exclude alleles from analysis if their supporting base quality is less than Q. Default value is changed according to the instruction of scSplit.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_supporting_allele_qsum`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Consider any allele in which the sum of qualities of supporting observations is at least Q.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_supporting_mapping_qsum`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Consider any allele in which and the sum of mapping qualities of supporting reads is at least.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--mismatch_base_quality_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Count mismatches toward --read-mismatch-limit if the base quality of the mismatch is >= Q.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `10`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--read_max_mismatch_fraction`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Exclude reads with more than N mismatches where each mismatch has base quality >= mismatch-base-quality-threshold.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--read_mismatch_limit`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Exclude reads with more than N [0,1] fraction of mismatches where each mismatch has base quality >= mismatch-base-quality-threshold.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--read_snp_limit`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Exclude reads with more than N base mismatches, ignoring gaps with quality >= mismatch-base-quality-threshold.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--read_indel_limit`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Exclude reads with more than N separate gaps.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--standard_filters`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Use stringent input base and mapping quality filters, equivalent to -m 30 -q 20 -R 0 -S 0
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_alternate_fraction`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Require at least this fraction of observations supporting an alternate allele within a single individual in order to evaluate the position.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.05`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_alternate_count`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Require at least this count of observations supporting an alternate allele within a single individual in order to evaluate the position.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `2`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_alternate_qsum`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Require at least this sum of quality of observations supporting an alternate allele within a single individual in order to evaluate the position.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_alternate_total`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Require at least this count of observations supporting an alternate allele within the total population in order to use the allele in analysis.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_coverage`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Require at least this coverage to process a site.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--max_coverage`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Do not process sites with greater than this coverage.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--no_population_priors`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Equivalent to --pooled-discrete --hwe-priors-off and removal of Ewens Sampling Formula component of priors.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--hwe_priors_off`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Disable estimation of the probability of the combination arising under HWE given the allele frequency as estimated by observation frequency.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--binomial_obs_priors_off`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Disable incorporation of prior expectations about observations. Uses read placement probability, strand balance probability, and read position probability.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--allele_balance_priors_off`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Disable use of aggregate probability of observation balance between alleles as a component of the priors.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--observation_bias`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Read length-dependent allele observation biases from FILE. The format is [length] [alignment efficiency relative to reference] where the efficiency is 1 if there is no relative observation bias.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"observation_bias.txt"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--base_quality_cap`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Limit estimated observation quality by capping base quality at Q.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--prob_contamination`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
An estimate of contamination to use for all samples.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1e-08`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--legacy_gls`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Use legacy (polybayes equivalent) genotype likelihood calculations
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--contamination_estimates`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
A file containing per-sample estimates of contamination, such as those generated by VerifyBamID.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"contamination_estimates.txt"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--report_genotype_likelihood_max`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Report genotypes using the maximum-likelihood estimate provided from genotype likelihoods.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--genotyping_max_iterations`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Iterate no more than N times during genotyping step.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1000`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--genotyping_max_banddepth`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Integrate no deeper than the Nth best genotype by likelihood when genotyping.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `6`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--posterior_integration_limits`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Integrate all genotype combinations in our posterior space which include no more than N samples with their Mth best data likelihood.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"1,3"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--exclude_unobserved_genotypes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Skip sample genotypings for which the sample has no supporting reads.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--genotype_variant_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Limit posterior integration to samples where the second-best genotype likelihood is no more than log(N) from the highest genotype likelihood for the sample.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--use_mapping_quality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Use mapping quality of alleles when calculating data likelihoods.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--harmonic_indel_quality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Use a weighted sum of base qualities around an indel, scaled by the distance from the indel. By default use a minimum BQ in flanking sequence.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--read_dependence_factor`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Incorporate non-independence of reads by scaling successive observations by this factor during data likelihood calculations.
:::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/genetic_demux/freebayes/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/genetic_demux/freebayes);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/genetic_demux/freebayes/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
